description: Links for a person who wants to keep following a Substack writer's growth, and for a writer who wants to claim their own page. Use it when the user asks to track, follow, watch or get updates on a writer (a reader, sponsor or brand), or says they are the writer. A reader gets the writer's page and a link that adds the writer to their watchlist once they confirm on the page; a writer gets a link to claim their page. Also says what the free plan and Pro include. Creates nothing: the person acts on the site.

audience.description: reader (default): someone who wants to follow the writer. writer: the writer, who wants to claim their page.

handle.description: The writer: a Substack handle (kyla or @kyla), a profile link, a publication address such as kyla.substack.com or a custom domain, or the writer's name.

name: get_follow_links
